campaign_rulings.summary: If starting Identities lack Malfunctioning, the player selects an ordinary starting slot to replace with a current Identity; preserve protected and extra Identities.
campaign_rulings.source: Owner reply in this development conversation, 2026-11-04

campaign_rulings.summary: Creature Comforts, Privacy and Asset Installment each cost 1 Permission.
campaign_rulings.source: Owner reply in this development conversation, 2026-11-04

campaign_rulings.summary: The current Handler explicitly quotes the price of each extra Asset repair during the Budget shortage; no default repair price is assumed.
campaign_rulings.source: Owner reply in this development conversation, 2026-11-04

campaign_rulings.summary: The current Ace receives the extra mission-end Permission even if it did not participate.
campaign_rulings.source: Owner approval in this development conversation

campaign_rulings.summary: The inflictor chooses unspecified Punishment details, including Identities and Assets. Explicit printed choice ownership overrides this default.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF 17–18 / printed pp.15–16; owner decision

campaign_rulings.summary: One actual Punishment may satisfy both mission-failure and Dog causes for the same Girl in the same mission; both causes remain audited.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF 16–17 / printed pp.14–15; owner decision

campaign_rulings.summary: Sedation marks all remaining Identities when fewer than two remain and reduces Heat to zero. Explicit Paired Identity effects still apply.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF 17 / printed p.15; owner approved the recommended fallback

campaign_rulings.summary: Resolve Princess Status promotion first; if now Ace, grant its Princess Permission. Normal mission completion and Ace bonuses follow separately.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF 32 / printed p.30; owner approved checking Ace after promotion

campaign_rulings.summary: The current Handler specifies each compulsory Frame replacement package case by case; no automatic starting Asset/ability package is assumed.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF 71 / printed p.69 and PDF 29 / printed p.27; owner decision

campaign_rulings.summary: A compulsory replacement must use a different official Frame playbook; cosmetic aliases do not bypass the restriction.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF 71 / printed p.69 and PDF 29 / printed p.27; owner decision

campaign_rulings.summary: Compulsory Frame replacement after scrapping or destruction costs no Permissions. The optional paid Frame Swap is separate.
campaign_rulings.source: Book PDF 16, 29 and 71 / printed pp.14, 27, 69; owner decision
